model.name: Site-specific cumulative yield models
model.validation: Nested cross-validation within site; fixed outer folds across TP1–TP6 (5 folds, Missouri Valley 4 folds); model selected by inner-CV MAE
model.description: At each satellite cutoff the system uses only information available through that date. Candidate models include Random Forest, HistGradientBoosting, XGBoost, CatBoost and ElasticNet. The deployed forecast retains the best inner-validated model available so far.

interval.method: CV+ conformal prediction; site-specific nested cross-validation

uav.framework: Same matched plots; agronomic + satellite versus agronomic + satellite + UAV
uav.note: UAV provided a small incremental gain beyond satellite imagery in this matched subset.
